instruction: Use FLORIS 4.6.4 from the command line to optimize a four-turbine layout. Start at layout_x = [0, 500, 0, 500] m and layout_y = [0, 0, 500, 500] m with four nrel_5MW turbines. Use wind directions [270, 280, 290] deg, wind speeds [8, 8, 8] m/s, turbulence intensities [0.06, 0.06, 0.06], and frequencies [0.5, 0.3, 0.2]. Constrain every turbine to the polygon (-100,-100), (600,-100), (600,600), (-100,600) and require minimum spacing 378 m. Write /home/user/Desktop/layout_opt.py using FLORIS LayoutOptimizationScipy or another SciPy optimizer, compute frequency-weighted annual energy before and after optimization, and verify all pairwise distances. Write /home/user/Desktop/summary.txt as initial_aep_gwh, optimized_aep_gwh, min_spacing_m. The optimized AEP must improve on the initial AEP while satisfying the spacing and boundary constraints; exact optimized coordinates may vary by optimizer/platform. Do not use a GUI.
